## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the user-visible problem, the change, and the related issue.

## Verification

List checks actually run and their results. Link the GitHub Actions run for the complete suite. Identify untested platforms or behavior. Add a screenshot for UI changes using synthetic media.

## Data integrity and compatibility

Describe any effect on file writes, backups, restoration, metadata identity, supported formats, or offline operation. Write “No change” when applicable.

## AI assistance

If used, briefly name the tools and describe your own review and verification. No prompt transcripts are needed.

- [ ] I understand the change and have read CONTRIBUTING.md.

- [ ] This contribution contains no private media, metadata, profiles, backups, or credentials.
